5cm-cherry-blossom-speed.line: 樱花飘落的速度，是秒速五厘米。
5cm-cherry-blossom-speed.line_en: Cherry blossoms fall at five centimeters per second.

akira-power-akira.line: 阿基拉的力量正在觉醒。

all-about-mother-authentic.line: 你可以比你想象的更真实。
all-about-mother-authentic.line_en: You can be more authentic than you imagine.

amores-perros-title.director: 亚历杭德罗·冈萨雷斯·伊纳里图
amores-perros-title.line_en: Love is a bitch. / Amores perros.

annie-hall-need-the-eggs.line_en: I guess we need the eggs.

arrietty-borrower.film_title: 借东西的小人阿莉埃蒂
arrietty-borrower.film_title_en: 借りぐらしのアリエッティ
arrietty-borrower.line: 我叫阿莉埃蒂。我是个借东西的小人。

audition-deeper.line: 再往深处，痛才会变成爱。
audition-deeper.line_en: Only deeper does pain turn into love.

babam-ve-oglum-come-back.character: 侯赛因（祖父）/ Hüseyin（策展概括）
babam-ve-oglum-come-back.line: 儿子，有些错，一辈子也还不完。
babam-ve-oglum-come-back.line_en: Some mistakes, my son, can never be repaid.

basterds-my-masterpiece.line: 尤蒂维奇，我觉得这大概是我的杰作。
basterds-my-masterpiece.line_en: You know somethin', Utivich? I think this just might be my masterpiece.

before-midnight-say-or-age.line: 我们可以把一切说清楚——或者就这样一起老去。
before-midnight-say-or-age.line_en: We can say everything out loud—or grow old together anyway.

black-narcissus-all-in-your-mind.director: 迈克尔·鲍威尔 / 埃默里克·普雷斯伯格
black-narcissus-all-in-your-mind.line: 这一切都在你的脑子里。

blue-choker-visible-wound.line: 脖子上的蓝色勒痕，是他们不肯看见的证据。
blue-choker-visible-wound.line_en: The blue mark on the neck is the evidence they refuse to see.

bourne2-remember-everything.line: 我都想起来了。我全都想起来了。

breathless-run.character: 米歇尔／帕特里夏 / Michel / Patricia
breathless-run.line: 跑着的人最怕停下来——停下来就要承认自己在逃。
breathless-run.line_en: Those who keep running fear stopping most — to stop is to admit they are fleeing.

bucket-measure-yourself.line: 衡量自己的标准，是那些以你为标准的人。
bucket-measure-yourself.line_en: You measure yourself by the people who measure themselves by you.

butch-who-are-those-guys.film_title_en: Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid

casanova-empty-seduction.line: 我征服的不是女人，是她们愿意被征服的幻想。
casanova-empty-seduction.line_en: I do not conquer women — I conquer the fantasy that they wish to be conquered.

chamber-our-choices.film_title_en: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
chamber-our-choices.line: 决定我们成为什么人的，不是我们的能力，而是我们的选择。
chamber-our-choices.line_en: It is our choices, Harry, that show what we truly are, far more than our abilities.

choristes-music.line: 永远别说永远，凡事都有可能。
choristes-music.line_en: Never say never — anything is possible.

city-of-god-sun-rises.director: 费尔南多·梅里尔斯 / 卡迪亚·隆登堡
city-of-god-sun-rises.line: 太阳，只为早起的人升起。
city-of-god-sun-rises.line_en: The sun rises for those who get up early.

closely-watched-trains-final-exam.line_en: Now, I have finally grown up.

cries-whispers-hold-me.line_en: I am in pain. I need someone to hold me.

daybreak-attic.line: 天亮以前，阁楼里只剩一个人，和还没讲完的理由。
daybreak-attic.line_en: Before daybreak, only one man remains in the attic — and a reason still unfinished.

despicable-best-dad.director: 皮埃尔·柯芬 / 克里斯·雷纳德
despicable-best-dad.line: 我曾经想做最坏的人。现在只想做最好的爸爸。
despicable-best-dad.line_en: I used to want to be the greatest villain. Now I just want to be the best dad.

dolce-vita-sweet.line: 甜蜜的生活，甜的是灯光，苦的是清晨。
dolce-vita-sweet.line_en: The sweet life: lights are sweet, mornings are bitter.

dreamers-cinema-love.character: 玛修／伊萨贝尔／西奥 / Matthew / Isabelle / Theo
dreamers-cinema-love.line: 我们用电影相爱，也用街头去革命。
dreamers-cinema-love.line_en: We fell in love through cinema — and took the streets for revolution.

duoming-cash.line: 股票，是人对未来的预测。测对了，就是赢家；测错了，就是输家。
duoming-cash.line_en: Stocks are people's predictions of the future. Guess right, you're a winner; guess wrong, you're a loser.

eeaao-be-here-with-you.line: 在所有可能的地方，我只想和你待在这里。
eeaao-be-here-with-you.line_en: Of all the places I could be, I just want to be here with you.

end-summer-family-ends.character: 小早川家众人 / The Kohayagawa family
end-summer-family-ends.line_en: This family — this is how it ends.

ferris-fast.line: 人生过得很快。如果你不时停下来四处看看，可能就会错过它。
ferris-fast.line_en: Life moves pretty fast. If you don't stop and look around once in a while, you could miss it.

fitzcarraldo-dream.character: 布赖恩·斯威尼·菲茨杰拉德
fitzcarraldo-dream.line_en: A man must have a dream.

forrest-chocolate.line: 生活就像一盒巧克力，你永远不知道下一颗是什么味道。
forrest-chocolate.line_en: Life is like a box of chocolates. You never know what you're gonna get.

furnace-unchanged.line: 我们一路奋战，不是为了改变世界，而是为了不让世界改变我们。
furnace-unchanged.line_en: We fight on, not to change the world, but so the world won't change us.

gbu-there-are-two-kinds.film_title_en: Il buono, il brutto, il cattivo
gbu-there-are-two-kinds.line: 世界上有两种人，我的朋友——有枪的，和要挖的。你，挖。
gbu-there-are-two-kinds.line_en: There are two kinds of people in the world, my friend: those with a loaded gun, and those who dig. You dig.

godfather2-enemies-closer.line: 亲近你的朋友，更要亲近你的敌人。
godfather2-enemies-closer.line_en: Keep your friends close, but your enemies closer.

goodbye-dragon-haunted.line: 你知道吗，这家戏院闹鬼。闹鬼。有鬼。
goodbye-dragon-haunted.line_en: Do you know this theater is haunted? This theater is haunted. Ghosts.

great-beauty-high-life.line: 我并不是想过上那种生活，我是想成为那种生活的王。
great-beauty-high-life.line_en: I didn't just want to live the high life — I wanted to be king of the high life.

green-tea-rice-home.film_title_en: The Flavor of Green Tea over Rice
green-tea-rice-home.line: 家的味道，往往是最普通的那一碗。
green-tea-rice-home.line_en: The taste of home is often the plainest bowl.

hamilton-not-throwing-away-shot.line_en: I'm not throwing away my shot.

harry-sally-having.character: 邻桌老妇人 / Older Woman Customer

herzglas-formula.line: 我望向远方，望向世界的尽头。这一天结束之前，末日就会到来。
herzglas-formula.line_en: I look into the distance, to the end of the world. Before the day is over, the end will come.

hobbit-going-on-adventure.character: 比尔博·巴金斯 / Bilbo Baggins

hope-be-child.line: 你不需要变得很坚强，可以向我们撒娇，有爸爸在呢。
hope-be-child.line_en: You don't have to be strong. You can lean on us—Dad is here.

hunter-love-hate.line: 指节上刻着爱与恨——孩子们比大人更早认出哪一只手。
hunter-love-hate.line_en: Love and Hate are tattooed on the knuckles — children recognize which hand first.

ichi-killer-pain.line: 有人靠施暴活着，有人靠挨打才觉得自己还在。
ichi-killer-pain.line_en: Some live by dealing pain; some only feel alive when they take it.

inception-dreams.line: 一个想法就像病毒，有韧性，极具传染力。
inception-dreams.line_en: An idea is like a virus. Resilient. Highly contagious.

intouchables-live.director: 奥利维·那卡什 / 艾瑞克·托莱达诺
intouchables-live.line: 我真正的残疾，不是坐在轮椅上，而是没有她的世界。
intouchables-live.line_en: My true disability isn't the wheelchair — it's living without her.

jaws-bigger-boat.line: 你们需要一艘更大的船。
jaws-bigger-boat.line_en: You're gonna need a bigger boat.

joker-tragedy-comedy.line: 我曾以为我的人生是部悲剧，现在我明白了——它是部喜剧。
joker-tragedy-comedy.line_en: I used to think that my life was a tragedy, but now I realize it's a comedy.

kagemusha-shadow-man.line_en: Even a shadow has its own fate.

kiki-still-can-fly.character: 琪琪 / 乌尔斯拉语境
kiki-still-can-fly.line: 魔女的能力，有时候会消失——但心在，就能再飞起来。
kiki-still-can-fly.line_en: We fly with our spirit. When that fades, so does our magic—until the heart finds it again.

kiss-box.character: 克里斯蒂娜·贝利 / Christina Bailey
kiss-box.line: 如果我们到不了……记住我。

l-atalante-love-you.line: 我不知道你对我做了什么，但我爱你。
l-atalante-love-you.line_en: I don’t know what you do to me, but I love you.

last-crusade-he-chose-poorly.film_title: 印第安纳琼斯：圣战奇兵
last-crusade-he-chose-poorly.film_title_en: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade

leon-childhood.line: 人生总是这么痛苦吗？还是只有童年如此？
leon-childhood.line_en: Is life always this hard, or is it just when you're a kid?

life-on-a-string-thousand-strings.character: 师父嘱托 / The master’s charge
life-on-a-string-thousand-strings.line: 弹断一千根弦，就能看到这个世界。
life-on-a-string-thousand-strings.line_en: Break a thousand strings, and you will see the world.

local-hero-beautiful-place.character: 菲利克斯·哈珀 / Felix Happer

lost-children-no-dreams.director: 让-皮埃尔·热内、马克·卡罗
lost-children-no-dreams.line: 偷走孩子的梦，是因为自己再也梦不着。
lost-children-no-dreams.line_en: He steals children's dreams because he can no longer dream.

mad-max-we-are-not-things.film_title: 疯狂的麦克斯4：狂暴之路

manhattan-faith-in-people.line: 对人，你总得有一点点信心。
manhattan-faith-in-people.line_en: You have to have a little faith in people.

mean-streets-sins-in-streets.line: 你不会在教堂里赎罪，你得在街上赎罪。
mean-streets-sins-in-streets.line_en: You don’t make up for your sins in church; you do it in the streets.

miracle-room7-gift.line: 这是爸爸送给你的礼物。
miracle-room7-gift.line_en: This is Daddy's present for you.

mustang-we-will-leave.director: 德尼兹·加姆泽·厄尔居文
mustang-we-will-leave.line: 有一天我们会离开这里。不是逃走，是出发。
mustang-we-will-leave.line_en: One day we'll leave this place — not fleeing, but setting out.

narayama-mountain-waits.line_en: The mountain is waiting for me.

no-country-coin-toss.director: 乔尔·科恩 / 伊桑·科恩
no-country-coin-toss.line: 你在一次抛硬币上，最多输过多少？
no-country-coin-toss.line_en: What's the most you ever lost on a coin toss?

nuan-warmth-missed.line_en: What feels warmest is often what we missed.

okuribito-send-off.line: 把逝者送上旅途，是为了让生者继续前行。
okuribito-send-off.line_en: We send the dead on their way so the living can go on.

oppenheimer-become-death.character: 罗伯特·奥本海默 / J. Robert Oppenheimer
oppenheimer-become-death.line: 现在我成了死神，世界的毁灭者。
oppenheimer-become-death.line_en: Now I am become Death, the destroyer of worlds.

paisan-chapters.line: 解放不是一条直线，是六段还来不及互相认识的善意。
paisan-chapters.line_en: Liberation is not a straight line — it is six chapters of goodwill that never quite meet.

parasite-no-plan.line: 你知道什么计划不会失败吗？没有计划。
parasite-no-plan.line_en: You know what kind of plan never fails? No plan at all.

peeping-tom-film-fear.line: 我不想杀你，我只是想拍下你害怕的样子。
peeping-tom-film-fear.line_en: I don’t want to kill you; I only want to film the look of fear.

piano-call-me-charlie.character: 查理·科勒／爱德华·萨罗扬 / Charlie Kohler

pirates-almost-caught.film_title_en: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
pirates-almost-caught.line: 今天，将是你永远记得的日子——差点抓住杰克·斯派洛船长的日子！
pirates-almost-caught.line_en: This is the day you will always remember as the day you almost caught Captain Jack Sparrow!

pom-poko-transform-to-survive.character: 狸猫族群 / The tanuki community
pom-poko-transform-to-survive.line: 不变成人类，我们就活不下去了。
pom-poko-transform-to-survive.line_en: If we don’t turn into humans, we won’t survive.

potter-wizard.film_title_en: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone

rambo-firstblood.line: 是他们先见了血，不是我。
rambo-firstblood.line_en: They drew first blood, not me.

rear-window-we-are-peeping.line_en: We've become a race of peeping Toms.

reinette-mirabelle.film_title: 蕾妮特和米拉贝尔的四个冒险
reinette-mirabelle.film_title_en: Four Adventures of Reinette and Mirabelle
reinette-mirabelle.character: 蕾妮特／米拉贝尔 / Reinette / Mirabelle
reinette-mirabelle.line: 巴黎与乡村之间，四则小品刚好够谈完一次友谊。
reinette-mirabelle.line_en: Between Paris and the countryside, four sketches are just enough to finish one friendship.

robot-dreams-come-back.line: 有些朋友离开了，也会以另一种方式回来。
robot-dreams-come-back.line_en: Some friends leave—and still find another way back.

room-view-vision-within.line: 我的视界在心里！鸟在这儿歌唱，天在这儿湛蓝！
room-view-vision-within.line_en: My vision is within! Here is where the birds sing; here is where the sky is blue!

rules-everyone-has-reasons.line: 人生可怕之处就在于：人人都有自己的理由。
rules-everyone-has-reasons.line_en: The awful thing about life is this: everyone has their reasons.

salaire-dead-is-dead.line_en: When someone is dead, they are dead.

scarface-say-hello.line: 你们这帮龟孙子想要打仗——是吗？来啊！……跟我的小朋友问个好！
scarface-say-hello.line_en: Say hello to my little friend!

seven-pounds-seven-seconds.line: 上帝用七天创造了世界。而我，用七秒钟就摧毁了自己的世界。
seven-pounds-seven-seconds.line_en: In seven days, God created the world. And in seven seconds, I shattered mine.

shrek-onions.director: 安德鲁·亚当森／维琪·詹森

skyfall-old-ways.line: 有时候，老办法才是最好的办法。
skyfall-old-ways.line_en: Sometimes the old ways are the best.

songs-second-floor-beloved.line_en: Beloved be the one who sits down.

spotlight-village.character: 米切尔·加拉贝迪安 / Mitchell Garabedian
spotlight-village.line: 如果说养大一个孩子需要一整个村子，那么虐待一个孩子，也需要一整个村子。
spotlight-village.line_en: If it takes a village to raise a child, it takes a village to abuse one.

stolen-kisses-antoine.line: 爱情像偷来的吻，甜，可总怕被发现。
stolen-kisses-antoine.line_en: Love is like stolen kisses — sweet, and always afraid of being caught.

sugata-throw.line: 教这样的人柔道，就像把刀交给疯子。
sugata-throw.line_en: Teaching judo to such a man is like giving a knife to a lunatic.

sunset-ready-for-closeup.line: 好了，科长——我准备好拍特写了。
sunset-ready-for-closeup.line_en: All right, Mr. DeMille, I'm ready for my close-up.

the-general-believe-can-do-it.line_en: I believe I can do it.

thin-blue-line-didnt-kill.character: 兰道尔·亚当斯 / Randall Adams

three-times-best-of-times.line: 最好的时光，总在回望里。
three-times-best-of-times.line_en: The best of times live in looking back.

titane-metal.character: 阿莱克西娅／樊尚 / Alexia / Vincent
titane-metal.line: 身体可以长出金属，爱却还得用人的样子去求。
titane-metal.line_en: The body can grow metal — love still has to beg in a human shape.

tokyo-twilight-lonely.line_en: When people get lonely, they go bad.

twelve-years-want-to-live.character: 所罗门·诺萨普 / Solomon Northup
twelve-years-want-to-live.line: 我不想只是活下来。我想要生活。
twelve-years-want-to-live.line_en: I don't want to survive. I want to live.

up-adventure.director: 彼特·道格特 / 鲍勃·彼德森

veronika-morphine.character: 维洛尼卡·福斯 / Veronika Voss
veronika-morphine.line: 明星的光晕褪尽之后，吗啡比镜头更听话。
veronika-morphine.line_en: After a star's halo fades, morphine obeys better than the camera.

walle-live.line: 我不想只是活着，我想要生活。
walle-live.line_en: I don't want to survive. I want to live.

weekend-not-a-novel.line: 这不是小说，这是电影。电影就是生活。
weekend-not-a-novel.line_en: This isn't a novel, it's a film. A film is life.

wind-rises-must-live.line_en: The wind is rising! We must try to live.

wolf-sell-pen.character: 乔丹·贝尔福特 / Jordan Belfort

wreaths-debt-remains.film_title_en: Wreaths at the Foot of the Mountain
wreaths-debt-remains.line: 人可以倒下，账不能烂在心里。
wreaths-debt-remains.line_en: A man may fall, but the debt must not rot in the heart.

yonosuke-kind.line: 温和到不像这个时代的人，反而把时代照得更清楚。
yonosuke-kind.line_en: Someone too gentle for his time ends up lighting that time more clearly.

zatoichi-blind-sees.line: 就算眼睛睁得再大，我也看不见什么——可我听得见。
zatoichi-blind-sees.line_en: Even with eyes wide open I see little — but I can hear.
